calls.title: Growth Wizards <> GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to improve lead generation, aiming to raise the current conversion rate of 53% by refining their ideal customer profile and tracking lead sources more effectively. They addressed the need for optimized follow-up processes from podcast guest engagements to sales reps, proposing automation and immediate scheduling techniques. Enhancements in pipeline transparency were emphasized, particularly for tracking podcast-related opportunities in CRM to bolster performance reporting. To increase engagement, the newsletter distribution is shifting to personal LinkedIn profiles, projected to enhance reach by 5-10 times. A focus on upcoming events, specifically the AI Engineer World’s Fair, offers an opportunity to engage potential leads. Biweekly syncs between sales and marketing teams were proposed to improve collaboration and streamline processes.
